title: Does nothing, or hurts with more copies
items: Boosts the 'every 4th attack' hit. No hero has that counter any more (it went in the hero rework), so it does nothing at 1 or 20 copies.
Make it its own counter: every 4th basic attack of the holder deals +50% damage per copy.
Every copy adds upkeep (the holder loses 6% attack speed and 6% defense per copy) but all item minions share one cap of 4. At 10 copies the holder is -60%, at 20 copies -120%.
Upkeep counts once per item. Copies past the cap make the minions stronger: +25% health and attack per copy.
Same as Rat Cage: upkeep grows with every copy, the minion cap does not.
Same as Rat Cage: upkeep grows with every copy, the minion cap does not.

title: Stops growing: copies after a point are wasted
note: This is the Soul Lantern problem you spotted.
items: -5% cooldown per copy, stops at 50% (10 copies). Copies 11+ add nothing.
Keep the 50% stop (0 cooldown would break skills). After it, each copy gives +6% skill damage.
Echo chance stops at 60% (4 copies); echo strength stops at 100% (5 copies). Copies 6+ add nothing.
Chance gets slowly closer to 90% instead of stopping. Echo strength keeps rising +10% per copy past 100%.
Converts 40% of overheal per copy, stops at 100% (3 copies). The shield cap stays 25% max health however many rings.
Shield cap +25% max health per ring.
Only the first hit each floor. The cut goes 60%, 70%, 78%... and stops at 90% around copy 6.
Each copy also covers one more hit per floor (5 copies = the first 5 hits are cut).
Weak minion cap +2 per copy, stops at +6 (3 copies). The 'kill raises a skeleton' part never grows.
Past the cap, each copy gives every minion +15% health and attack.
Minion cap +1 per copy stops at +4. The +15% attack speed keeps growing.
Fine after the cap thanks to the speed. Optional: past 4, +5% minion damage per copy.
Spreads poison to +1 enemy per copy, but fights have at most 3-4 enemies. Copies 3+ do nothing.
Copies past 2: each spreads 25% more poison stacks.
Tornado chance shrinks per copy (x0.85) and there is a hard limit of 3 tornadoes at once.
Each copy past the first also makes tornadoes hit 20% harder. Raise the limit by 1 per 3 copies.
Max 10 copies (+75 crit). Crit stops at 100% anyway.
Remove the max. Crit above 100% turns into crit damage (+1% per point).
Remove the max, same crit overflow rule as Lucky Coin.
Max 8 copies (+64 evasion). Evasion stops at 70% anyway.
Remove the max. Evasion above 70 turns into a 'dodge and strike back' chance.
Remove the max. Copies past 6: block recharges 10% faster each.

title: Extra copies add almost nothing
note: The first copy works; more copies barely change anything.
items: The 5% chance never grows (it is 'unique'); copies only add +0.5s duration.
The 8% step-in chance never grows; copies only shorten its cooldown.
The 10% pop-out chance never grows; copies only make the mimic stronger.
The heal is always 30%; copies are only spare flasks (one per floor).
Each copy in the bag also adds +10% to the heal.
Curse from the same hero only refreshes. After 2-3 copies it is always on, so more copies add nothing.
Copies make the curse deeper: -15 resist, then -3 more per extra copy.
Same as Hex Doll, with Armor Break.
Copies make the armor break deeper: -15 defense, then -3 more per copy.
+2% per hit in a row, max +10% per copy. 20 copies would need 100 hits in a row on one enemy, which never happens.
+2% per hit PER COPY (the max still grows by 10% per copy).
Chance shrinks per copy (x0.8): it never gets past about 50% total.
Heal shrinks per copy (x0.85): it never gets past about 33%.

title: Grows fine, but only shows in the right build
note: The numbers add up every copy; they just need their partner (the bench can't show it). No change needed.
items: +15% ice damage per copy. Few things deal ice yet (Chill Band, Mage spells).
+15% electric damage per copy. Needs Static Crystal, the Mage's lightning or Storm Sprites' kind of damage.
+25% vs burning per copy keeps growing; the faster-burn part stops at 4 copies.
+20% vs bleeding and +3% heal per copy. Needs bleed.
+60% vs frozen per copy. Needs freeze.
+30% vs 3+ debuffs per copy. Needs debuffs.
+30% shield size per copy. Needs shields.
+80% burst per copy when a shield breaks. Needs shields.
+1s silence per copy. Only enemies with skills (bosses) care.
+12 defense per copy (each point worth a bit less past 50).
+30 defense and +25% reflect while taunting, per copy.

title: Good: every copy adds a real chunk
